SYNTHETIC MAINTENANCE MANUAL — NOT A TECHNICAL ORDER

This file is a demonstration fixture for the s3a-pack-to crate.
It contains no ETIMS content, no official USAF Technical Order text,
and no OEM manual excerpts. All names, part numbers, procedures,
values, and figures are invented for software tests.

Document-ID: SYN-DEMO-0001
Title: Demonstration Pump Assembly

Chapter 1  General
  Section 1  Scope
    Page 1
      This synthetic manual describes a fictional demonstration pump used only to exercise Technical Order record layouts.

    WARNING
      Do not operate the demonstration pump without the safety cap installed.

    CAUTION
      Do not exceed the demonstration discharge pressure shown in Table 1.

    NOTE
      The demonstration pump is a bench model and is not installed on any aircraft.

Chapter 2  Fault Isolation
  Section 1  Isolation Tree
    Page 2
      Node 1  TEST  Is the inlet valve open?
        YES -> Node 2
        NO  -> Node 3
      Node 2  TEST  Is discharge pressure within Table 1 limits?
        YES -> Node 4
        NO  -> Node 5
      Node 3  ACTION  Open the inlet valve.
      Node 4  CONCLUSION  Demonstration system is normal.
      Node 5  ACTION  Replace the demonstration pressure regulator.
